reviewStatus: AI scientific and marketing language review completed across all 1,429 keys and eight profiles; not certified native or legal/regulatory approval.
scientificRules: Preserve numerical precision, source measurements, units and references.
Preserve distinctions between measured evidence, modelled outcomes and planning assumptions.
All original source PDFs remain English-language scientific records.
Do not add certification, regulatory approval or universal validation claims.
Mobile-phase recycling routes selected suitable prepared mobile phase for reuse; never translate it as purification.
Translate analytical stability as 安定性 and environmental sustainability as 持続可能性.
Distinguish recorded volume (体積) from flow rate (流量), and measured routing recovery from independent annual net reduction assumptions.
LC/MS non-detection is limited to the named analytes and evaluated method; the source does not specify detection limits.
Use 物質収支, 分析の信頼性 and 他業務に活用できる作業時間 consistently.
